# v23 summary: reference measurements under the paper's rules (seeds 91-95; generated by report_v23.py)

Runs: 8370 of 8370; missing: 0; dead-end events: 0. DeFT-P = `-deft_up_keep 1 -deft_rr_fallback 1 -deft_vn_rr 1 -deft_lut_entry dst`; DeFT-B = the same VN options with the v1-v21 entry; DeFT (v19-v21) = `-deft_vn_rr 1` alone. Every VN-based method carries DeFT-P's VN options and `-traffic_rng 1`; MTR and RC carry `-vc_per_hop 1` (the static-VC rows without it). Loads: the 9-load ladders of `load_points_v23.json` (0.2-2.4 x Lsat of DeFT-P, per pipe depth); LAT and P99 at the 4th load (1.0 x Lsat), THR = the maximum accepted throughput over the 9 loads. MTR and RC: fault-free scenarios only (every comparison with them uses those).
